title: Tour: Listings
blurb: Keep your business details the same across online directories.

steps.title: Open Listings
steps.body: Click **Listings**. Online directory listings are managed here.

steps.title: What Listings does
steps.body: Listings sends your business name, address, phone and hours to 70+ directories so they match everywhere. That helps local search.

steps.title: Activate
steps.body: **Activate Listings** starts a paid plan. Your details then sync out to the directories.
steps.tip: Directory coverage varies by country. Check with us before you buy: hello@luubu.com

steps.title: Status
steps.body: Once active, you see each directory and its status. Waiting or in-review items usually clear within a few days.

steps.title: What's next
steps.body: Next: try **Get your business listed in online directories** from the Guide.
